				<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">POB Digital Products is looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Digital Product Manager to help manage our growing store of digital products. The role involves organizing products, improving product presentation, supporting uploads, and making sure our digital store is well structured and easy for customers to use.</p>
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">The ideal candidate should understand digital products, online stores, product organization, and basic e-commerce operations. You will help ensure that product information is accurate, product files are properly arranged, and the store remains clean, professional, and easy to navigate.</p>
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">This role is a good fit for someone who is organized, proactive, and able to work with minimal supervision. You should be comfortable handling product details, coordinating updates, and helping improve how digital products are displayed and sold on the platform.</p>
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p>
<ul class="marker:text-quiet list-disc pl-8">
<li class="py-0 my-0 prose-p:pt-0 prose-p:mb-2 prose-p:my-0 [&>p]:pt-0 [&>p]:mb-2 [&>p]:my-0">
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Manage and organize digital product listings.</p>
</li>
<li class="py-0 my-0 prose-p:pt-0 prose-p:mb-2 prose-p:my-0 [&>p]:pt-0 [&>p]:mb-2 [&>p]:my-0">
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Review product titles, descriptions, and categories.</p>
</li>
<li class="py-0 my-0 prose-p:pt-0 prose-p:mb-2 prose-p:my-0 [&>p]:pt-0 [&>p]:mb-2 [&>p]:my-0">
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Support the upload and update of digital products.</p>
</li>
<li class="py-0 my-0 prose-p:pt-0 prose-p:mb-2 prose-p:my-0 [&>p]:pt-0 [&>p]:mb-2 [&>p]:my-0">
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Ensure product files, images, and download links are properly arranged.</p>
</li>
<li class="py-0 my-0 prose-p:pt-0 prose-p:mb-2 prose-p:my-0 [&>p]:pt-0 [&>p]:mb-2 [&>p]:my-0">
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Improve product presentation and store structure.</p>
</li>
<li class="py-0 my-0 prose-p:pt-0 prose-p:mb-2 prose-p:my-0 [&>p]:pt-0 [&>p]:mb-2 [&>p]:my-0">
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Assist with product packaging and basic optimization.</p>
</li>
<li class="py-0 my-0 prose-p:pt-0 prose-p:mb-2 prose-p:my-0 [&>p]:pt-0 [&>p]:mb-2 [&>p]:my-0">
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Help maintain quality and consistency across the store.</p>
</li>
<li class="py-0 my-0 prose-p:pt-0 prose-p:mb-2 prose-p:my-0 [&>p]:pt-0 [&>p]:mb-2 [&>p]:my-0">
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Support day-to-day digital store operations.</p>
</li>
</ul>

<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Experience with digital products, e-commerce, or online store management.</p>
</li>
<li class="py-0 my-0 prose-p:pt-0 prose-p:mb-2 prose-p:my-0 [&>p]:pt-0 [&>p]:mb-2 [&>p]:my-0">
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Strong attention to detail.</p>
</li>
<li class="py-0 my-0 prose-p:pt-0 prose-p:mb-2 prose-p:my-0 [&>p]:pt-0 [&>p]:mb-2 [&>p]:my-0">
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Good communication and organizational skills.</p>

<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Ability to work independently.</p>

				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
								<div class="service-detail-description ">
				<p>I will edit a product explanatory video that helps your audience understand your brand’s offer in a clear, engaging, and professional way. The final video will be polished, easy to follow, and structured to highlight your product’s features, benefits, and value in a way that keeps viewers interested. Explainer-style videos work best when the message is simple, the pacing is tight, and the visuals support the story well.</p>
<p>Whether you need the video for your website, social media, ads, or product presentation, I will shape your raw clips, product footage, voiceover, and text into a compelling final video. I can add transitions, captions, motion graphics, music, and visual emphasis to make the explanation more attractive and persuasive. The goal is to give your product a professional presentation that improves understanding and helps convert viewers into customers.</p>
<p>This service is ideal for brands that want to explain what they sell, demonstrate how it works, and build trust with potential buyers. I focus on clear storytelling, smooth editing, and a clean visual style so the final result feels modern and effective</p>

				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Service Description</h2>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-31c5919 elementor-widget elementor-widget-apus_element_detail_service_description" data-id="31c5919" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="apus_element_detail_service_description.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
								<div class="service-detail-description ">
				<p>In today’s fast-moving digital space, static images and text posts simply get scrolled past. If your business is running advertising campaigns without dynamic, professionally edited video, you are leaving attention, leads, and revenue on the table. Customers make buying decisions based on emotion, clarity, and trust—and video delivers all three in seconds.</p>
<p>I produce high-impact, engaging promotional video advertisements engineered specifically to stop the scroll and convert viewers into paying customers. Whether you are launching a new product, promoting a limited-time offer, building brand awareness, or scaling paid campaigns across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, or YouTube, I bring your brand to life with crisp pacing, purposeful motion graphics, and a compelling call to action.</p>
<p>### What You Will Receive<br />
* **Strategic Visual Storytelling:** A tailored video narrative focused on your core value proposition and customer pain points.<br />
* **Scroll-Stopping Hook:** The first 3 to 5 seconds are crafted specifically to hook viewers before they swipe away.<br />
* **Motion Graphics & Animated Text Overlays:** Clear visual emphasis on key benefits, pricing, and features.<br />
* **Multi-Platform Aspect Ratios:** Optimized framing for Vertical Reels/TikTok (9:16), Feed (1:1), or Landscape YouTube/Website (16:9).<br />
* **Licensed Audio & Sound Design:** Background music and sound effects that match your brand tone.<br />
* **Clear Call-to-Action Integration:** Prompts that guide prospective buyers toward booking, messaging, or buying.</p>
<p>### What I Need From You<br />
1. Your brand logo in high resolution (PNG with transparent background or vector).<br />
2. Product or service photos, existing clips, or website links.<br />
3. Your key message, offer details, and target audience profile.<br />
4. Any specific brand colors, fonts, or reference video styles you like.</p>
<p>### Scope & Exclusions<br />
* This service covers promotional video editing, motion design, and audio-visual post-production.<br />
* Advertising budget/ad spend paid directly to Meta, Google, or TikTok is not included and remains the responsibility of the client.<br />
* Physical on-location filming crew services are not included; we work with your provided assets, high-definition stock footage, and motion animation.</p>

				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-31c5919 elementor-widget elementor-widget-apus_element_detail_service_description" data-id="31c5919" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="apus_element_detail_service_description.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
								<div class="service-detail-description ">
				<p>Modern consumers have developed blind spots for glossy, corporate commercials. They want authentic demonstrations, relatable angles, and honest visual storytelling that shows how a product or service works in everyday life. User-generated content (UGC) style videos consistently outperform traditional creative by creating instant trust and connection.</p>
<p>I produce UGC-style promotional videos designed to stop prospective customers from scrolling past your brand. With strong visual hooks, natural product presentations, crisp pacing, dynamic captions, and clear calls to action, your brand gets social-native creative that looks organic in the feed while delivering commercial results.</p>
<p>### What You Will Receive<br />
* **Organic, Mobile-Native Feel:** Vertical (9:16) format designed specifically for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.<br />
* **Scroll-Stopping Hooks:** Tested opening angles (e.g. "Stop scrolling if you need...", "The easiest way to solve...").<br />
* **Clear Product Demonstration:** Showing the product in action, highlighting key features, and demonstrating ease of use.<br />
* **Dynamic Captions:** On-screen text highlighting benefits for the 70%+ of users who watch videos on mute.<br />
* **Trending Audio & Pacing:** Background tracks and sound effects that keep viewer retention high.<br />
* **Authenticity Assurance:** Genuine product showcase and clear demonstration without fabricating false customer testimonials.</p>
<p>### What I Need From You<br />
1. Clear details about your product or service, core benefits, and target customer profile.<br />
2. Product photos, unboxing clips, screen recordings, or physical samples where applicable.<br />
3. Key problem your product solves and main calls to action (e.g. "Shop Now", "Download Today").<br />
4. Any specific visual guidelines, preferred tone, or brand highlights.</p>
<p>### Scope & Exclusions<br />
* This service provides UGC-style promotional creative and product demonstration video production.<br />
* We do not provide fake medical, financial, or legally regulated claims, nor do we fabricate false consumer testimonials.<br />
* Advertising spend for paid social platforms is not included and is managed directly by the buyer.</p>

						'DOMContentLoaded',

				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-31c5919 elementor-widget elementor-widget-apus_element_detail_service_description" data-id="31c5919" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="apus_element_detail_service_description.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
								<div class="service-detail-description ">
				<p>Every day, thousands of potential customers in Nigeria and across the globe are searching on Google for the exact products and services you offer. But without an expertly configured Google Ads campaign, your business stays invisible while competitors take those high-value customers. Even worse, poorly managed campaigns waste valuable budget on irrelevant clicks and low-intent search terms.</p>
<p>I set up and manage high-performing Google Ads campaigns engineered to drive real business outcomes—qualified inquiries, phone calls, bookings, and direct sales. By combining rigorous negative keyword filtering, precise audience targeting, persuasive ad copywriting, and smart bidding configurations, your advertising budget works efficiently to generate measurable returns.</p>
<p>### What You Will Receive<br />
* **In-Depth Keyword Research:** Identifying high-intent search terms with commercial buying intent.<br />
* **Negative Keyword Architecture:** Protecting your ad spend from wasting money on irrelevant clicks and job seekers.<br />
* **Responsive Search Ads Copywriting:** Engaging headlines and descriptions tailored to maximize quality scores and click-through rates.<br />
* **Asset & Extension Setup:** Sitelinks, callouts, structured snippets, and call extensions to dominate Google search result space.<br />
* **Conversion Tracking Verification:** Ensuring leads, phone calls, or purchases are accurately attributed.<br />
* **Campaign Management & Optimization:** Bid adjustments, search term pruning, and device bid modifiers during the active period.</p>
<p>### What I Need From You<br />
1. Access to your Google Ads account (standard access via your 10-digit Customer ID).<br />
2. Website URL and landing pages for the products or services you want to promote.<br />
3. Target geographical locations (e.g. Lagos, Abuja, all Nigeria, or international regions).<br />
4. Monthly advertising budget paid directly to Google.</p>
<p>### Scope & Important Information<br />
* **Freelancer Service Fee vs. Advertising Spend:** The price of this service covers professional campaign research, structure, copywriting, setup, and optimization. Advertising spend is paid directly by you to Google via your linked billing card in your Google Ads account.<br />
* While we implement industry best practices to maximize quality score, lower CPC, and drive qualified clicks, Google rankings and click prices depend on auction dynamics and competition.</p>

				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-31c5919 elementor-widget elementor-widget-apus_element_detail_service_description" data-id="31c5919" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="apus_element_detail_service_description.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
								<div class="service-detail-description ">
				<p>Maintaining an active, professional social media presence is essential for building customer trust and driving repeat sales. However, business owners often struggle with inconsistent posting, low-quality graphics, lack of content ideas, and zero time to manage multiple social channels.</p>
<p>I take full ownership of your business social media pages, delivering a consistent stream of visually striking, value-packed content designed to strengthen your brand identity, engage your target audience, and turn casual followers into loyal brand advocates. From tailored graphics and engaging carousels to persuasive caption copywriting and hashtag optimization, your social media presence will look clean, active, and authoritative.</p>
<p>### What You Will Receive<br />
* **Strategic Content Calendar:** A structured monthly posting schedule reviewed and approved by you before anything goes live.<br />
* **Custom Branded Graphics:** Polished, professional designs aligned with your brand colors, fonts, and visual standards.<br />
* **Persuasive Caption Copywriting:** Clear, engaging copy that informs, entertains, and prompts user action.<br />
* **Hashtag & Keyword Research:** Researched hashtags and keyword-rich text to expand organic reach.<br />
* **Scheduled Publishing:** Content scheduled at optimal times when your audience is most active.<br />
* **Performance Reporting:** Clear monthly summary tracking growth, engagement rates, and top-performing posts.</p>
<p>### What I Need From You<br />
1. Access to your social media accounts or scheduling tool (e.g. Meta Business Suite, Buffer).<br />
2. Your brand assets: logo, brand colors, fonts, and product/service photography.<br />
3. Information about your target audience, core services, and upcoming promotions.<br />
4. Preferred tone of voice (e.g. professional, friendly, educational, bold).</p>
<p>### Scope & Exclusions<br />
* This service covers organic social media management, content planning, graphic creation, scheduling, and community monitoring.<br />
* Paid advertising spend for sponsored ad campaigns is not included in organic management packages.<br />
* Physical photography shoots are not included; we work with your provided assets and licensed creative libraries.</p>

				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-31c5919 elementor-widget elementor-widget-apus_element_detail_service_description" data-id="31c5919" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="apus_element_detail_service_description.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
								<div class="service-detail-description ">
				<p>Many business owners make the mistake of clicking the "Boost Post" button on social media, hoping for sales, only to find their money consumed by vanity likes and hollow clicks. Sponsored social media advertising is a serious marketing science that requires structured sales funnels, precise behavioral audience targeting, multi-angle creative testing, and rigorous conversion tracking.</p>
<p>I plan, build, and optimize high-converting sponsored advertising campaigns across Meta (Facebook & Instagram) and LinkedIn. By aligning campaign objectives with your specific business goals—lead generation, e-commerce orders, WhatsApp inquiries, or event registrations—I ensure your advertising capital is deployed strategically to achieve maximum return on ad spend (ROAS).</p>
<p>### What You Will Receive<br />
* **Strategic Campaign Architecture:** Proper separation of top-of-funnel prospecting, middle-of-funnel consideration, and bottom-of-funnel retargeting.<br />
* **Precise Audience Targeting:** Custom audiences, interest-based cohorts, lookalike audiences, and demographic exclusions.<br />
* **Compelling Ad Creative & Copy:** Persuasive headlines, hooks, and body copy written for high conversion.<br />
* **Tracking & Pixel Audit:** Ensuring the Meta Pixel or LinkedIn Insight Tag accurately tracks website events and purchases.<br />
* **A/B Split Testing:** Testing creative concepts, angles, and calls to action to identify winning assets quickly.<br />
* **Budget Optimization & Scaling:** Reallocating budget to top-performing ad sets while cutting unprofitable audiences.</p>
<p>### What I Need From You<br />
1. Access to your Meta Business Suite / Ad Account or LinkedIn Campaign Manager.<br />
2. Link to your website, landing page, or WhatsApp business number.<br />
3. Your product or service details, pricing, and main offer.<br />
4. Your advertising budget (paid directly to the ad platform).</p>
<p>### Scope & Transparency Guidelines<br />
* **Service Fee vs. Ad Spend:** The fee covers professional campaign strategy, setup, copywriting, audience research, and optimization. Ad spend is paid directly by the client to the advertising platform (Meta or LinkedIn).<br />
* We optimize campaigns following proven advertising frameworks, but conversion rates also depend on landing page quality, product pricing, and market demand.</p>

				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-31c5919 elementor-widget elementor-widget-apus_element_detail_service_description" data-id="31c5919" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="apus_element_detail_service_description.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
								<div class="service-detail-description ">
				<p>Search behavior is experiencing the biggest transformation in 25 years. Millions of consumers and decision-makers are no longer just browsing traditional Google blue links—they are querying AI search engines like ChatGPT Search, Perplexity AI, Claude, and Google AI Overviews to get direct, summarized answers and brand recommendations.</p>
<p>If your website and digital presence are not structured for Large Language Models (LLMs), AI answer engines cannot parse, verify, or cite your brand. Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and AI SEO establish clear entity identity, authoritative structured data, topical completeness, and citation-friendly content architecture so your business becomes the trusted source AI systems recommend.</p>
<p>### What You Will Receive<br />
* **AI Search Visibility Audit:** Evaluating how your brand, products, and executives are currently recognized and cited across major LLMs (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews).<br />
* **Entity & Knowledge Graph Alignment:** Defining your brand entity, schema relationships, and topical associations so AI models understand what you do with zero ambiguity.<br />
* **Content Hierarchy Optimization:** Structuring key landing pages and articles with direct answer formatting, clear definitions, and semantic HTML that LLM web crawlers prioritize.<br />
* **Structured Data & Schema Recommendations:** Rich JSON-LD schemas (Organization, Service, FAQ, Product, Author, ItemList) designed for machine readability.<br />
* **Topical Authority Roadmapping:** Identifying entity gaps and unanswered customer questions that generative search engines look to satisfy.<br />
* **Actionable Implementation Guide:** Step-by-step instructions for your web and content team to maintain ongoing AI search readiness.</p>
<p>### What I Need From You<br />
1. Your website URL and list of core products, services, or brand topics.<br />
2. Information about your company background, founders, certifications, and notable coverage.<br />
3. Access to your CMS (WordPress, Webflow, etc.) if you want structured data implemented directly.<br />
4. Top 5 to 10 queries where you want your brand to appear in AI search answers.</p>
<p>### Scope & Ethical Standards<br />
* AI SEO enhances your brand's digital authority, structural clarity, and citation probability across generative answer engines using verified entity-first methods.<br />
* In accordance with ethical standards, we do not promise guaranteed #1 rankings or manipulated AI hallucinations. Search algorithms and generative models update continuously.</p>

				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-31c5919 elementor-widget elementor-widget-apus_element_detail_service_description" data-id="31c5919" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="apus_element_detail_service_description.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
								<div class="service-detail-description ">
				<p>Paid advertising brings traffic only as long as you keep pumping money into it. When the ad budget stops, the leads vanish. Organic Search Engine Optimisation (SEO), by contrast, builds compounding digital equity for your website—attracting qualified prospective buyers month after month without paying for every individual click.</p>
<p>If your website suffers from sluggish loading speeds, broken links, missing meta tags, weak content structure, or poor mobile formatting, Google pushes your pages down the search rankings. I provide complete on-page and technical SEO improvements that align your website with Google's modern search quality standards, helping your business get discovered when customers search for what you sell.</p>
<p>### What You Will Receive<br />
* **Comprehensive Website SEO Audit:** Identifying indexation issues, crawl errors, broken links, and site speed bottlenecks.<br />
* **Commercial Keyword Research:** Uncovering high-intent search terms your potential buyers use.<br />
* **On-Page Optimization:** Writing optimized title tags, meta descriptions, header structures (H1, H2, H3), and image alt text.<br />
* **Content & Topical Improvements:** Enhancing text depth and keyword placement to satisfy user search intent.<br />
* **Technical SEO Fundamentals:** Reviewing XML sitemaps, robots.txt configuration, URL structure, and canonical tags.<br />
* **Internal Linking Blueprint:** Building clear logical links between related service pages to spread authority throughout your site.</p>
<p>### What I Need From You<br />
1. Your website URL and CMS access (e.g. WordPress, Shopify, Webflow) for direct implementation, or I can provide an implementation-ready action document.<br />
2. Target geographical market (Nigeria, specific cities, or global regions).<br />
3. Your top products, services, and primary competitors.<br />
4. Access to Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 (if available).</p>
<p>### Scope & White-Hat Commitment<br />
* We strictly adhere to white-hat Google Webmaster guidelines to protect your domain's long-term reputation and security.<br />
* We do not use manipulative black-hat link schemes, spamming, or fraudulent tactics.<br />
* Organic SEO is a compounding process; rankings depend on crawl cycles, content quality, and market competition. We do not make misleading promises of overnight #1 rankings.</p>
